parole.significato: A fermented drink made from wheat or millet, bosa.
parole.testo: One of two possibilities: * inherited from Ottoman Turkish بوزه, from Persian بوزه (buze). * Possibly from bozmak ("to blemish, to blight, to spoil or ruin") and Ottoman Turkish بوز (boz) ("Gray, Brown" - referring to the color of the beverage).
From Ottoman Turkish دار آغاجی (dar ağacı), from Persian دار (dâr) and Ottoman Turkish آغاج (ağac). Equivalent to dar + ağaç.
